children.text: This guide is intended as a guide for players looking to progress towards the tougher challenges RS3 PvM offers.
It covers skill goals to set on your PvM journey, how to improve your damage and useful unlocks for your PvM experience.
Before you begin, it can be helpful to get a few things out of the way:
⬥ Set up a good interface - see
⬥ Learn about the different combat modes (Revolution and Full Manual) -
that you can work on as you learn PvM.
Having an idea of some of the things you want to aim for initially can help with planning, which we cover here.
None of these things are strictly necessary, but are recommended to make your bossing learning curves an easier and more enjoyable experience.

In RuneScape, the best defence is a great offence. Improving your damage output will significantly increase your chances of success at whichever boss or slayer task you're trying to accomplish.
